title: 1.2 Physics Communities and Their Roles
description: Physics communities, their establishment levels, and the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS)

questions.question: What is a physics community?
options: An organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
A laboratory where physics experiments are performed
A collection of physics textbooks and journals
A government body that funds scientific research
questions.correctAnswer: An organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes

questions.question: For what purpose are persons associated together in a physics community?
How is a physics community best described?
options: As an organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
As a random gathering of individuals interested in nature
As a collection of scientific instruments
As a building used for physics lectures
questions.correctAnswer: As an organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes

questions.question: At which levels can physics communities be established?
What determines the level at which a physics organization is established?
A national physics society is an example of a physics community established at which level?
A continental physics association, such as an African one, represents which level of organization?
Which of the following is a worldwide (global) physics organization?
options: IUPAP - International Union of Pure and Applied Physics
questions.correctAnswer: IUPAP - International Union of Pure and Applied Physics

questions.question: What does IUPAP stand for?
options: International Union of Pure and Applied Physics
International Union of Physics and Astronomy Programs
Institute of Universal Physics and Applied Principles
International Understanding of Pure and Applied Physics
questions.correctAnswer: International Union of Pure and Applied Physics

questions.question: Which type of physics community is established at the worldwide (global) level?
options: An international union such as IUPAP
questions.correctAnswer: An international union such as IUPAP

questions.question: Which of the following is a role of physics communities?
How do physics communities share information with scientists?
Which of the following is an activity carried out by physics communities?
How do physics communities help students develop an interest in physics?
Which of the following is a benefit provided by physics communities?
What equipment support do physics communities provide?
What does EPS stand for?
Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS)?
options: To promote physics education and research in the country
questions.correctAnswer: To promote physics education and research in the country

questions.question: According to the objectives of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS), what does it organize and coordinate?
options: Conferences on physics education and exchange of scientific information
questions.correctAnswer: Conferences on physics education and exchange of scientific information

questions.question: Why does the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) popularize physics?
options: To make students develop interest in physics
To increase the number of physics teachers
To promote physics as a career option
questions.correctAnswer: To make students develop interest in physics

questions.question: In the design and implementation of the physics curriculum, whose active participation does the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) promote?
options: Ethiopian physicists and the general public
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopian physicists and the general public

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) regarding scientific information?
options: To create a means for disseminating scientific information
To restrict access to scientific information
To store scientific information for sale
questions.correctAnswer: To create a means for disseminating scientific information

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) regarding the physics curriculum?
options: To promote active participation in the design and implementation of the physics curriculum
To design an entirely new national curriculum
To approve textbooks for all subjects
To examine students on the physics curriculum
questions.correctAnswer: To promote active participation in the design and implementation of the physics curriculum

questions.question: Which of the following people are encouraged by the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) to take part in bringing about an effective physics curriculum?
options: Ethiopian physicists and the general public
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopian physicists and the general public

questions.question: At which level of organization is the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) established?
